name: Interlocking Gears
summary: Two meshing cogs of different sizes on a base plate that turn in opposite directions; for machinery and teamwork scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the base plate stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 540 px wide and 430 px tall (hero size); use about 0.3–0.4 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: spin = the big gear turns one way and the small gear the other, at matching tooth speed

author: krakujs
